elements.description: The files, code and documents a run produced: a list, a preview per type, versions with a diff, download.

properties.name: selected
properties.description: The id of the artifact shown; empty shows the first. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: version
properties.description: The id of the version shown; empty shows the latest. Changed by the user unless a tc-version-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: view
properties.description: "preview", or "diff" to compare the version with the one before. Changed by the user unless a tc-view-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the region's name

properties.name: emptyLabel
properties.description: Shown when there is nothing yet

properties.name: previewHeight
properties.description: The preview's height cap in px; longer content scrolls

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-selected-change
events.description: An artifact was picked in the list ({ id: string }); cancelable

events.name: tc-version-change
events.description: A version was picked, or picking another artifact went back to its latest ({ artifact: string, version: string }); cancelable

events.name: tc-view-change
events.description: Compare was turned on or off ({ view: "preview" | "diff" }); cancelable

events.name: tc-download
events.description: Download was pressed ({ artifact: Artifact, version: ArtifactVersion }); cancelable – unless prevented, the element saves the file

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the region's name

props.name: selected
props.description: The id of the artifact shown (controlled); empty shows the first

props.name: version
props.description: The id of the version shown (controlled); empty shows the latest

props.name: onVersionChange
props.description: A version was picked; picking another artifact goes back to its latest ("")

props.name: view
props.description: "preview", or "diff" to compare with the version before (controlled)

props.name: onDownload
props.type: (artifact: Artifact, version: ArtifactVersion, event: Event) => void
props.description: Download was pressed. The panel saves the file itself unless you call event.preventDefault()

changelog: `tc-artifact-panel` – what a run produced: a list, a preview per kind (Markdown text, code through `tc-code-block`, images, tables from CSV), versions with a diff against the one before, and download (a Blob by default, cancelable).
